daily.summary: Ethiopia’s army chief accused Eritrea and Sudan on Sunday of backing armed groups fighting federal troops, as clashes with Tigrayan rebels intensified. daily.title: Trump expects Iran talks next week after rejecting seven-day truce proposal
daily.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Sunday he expected talks with Iran to resume next week, despite rejecting Tehran’s proposal for a seven-day truce followed by the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Trump has raised the possibility of renewed air strikes on Iran, but told Axios he anticipated further negotiations.

daily.title: Aux Mondiaux de cyclisme, le « miracle » de Brandon McNulty éclipse l’« énorme déception » de Paul Seixas

daily.title: Israel revokes credentials of Dutch diplomats in West Bank over settlement goods ban
daily.summary: Israel will revoke the diplomatic accreditation of Dutch officials based in the occupied West Bank after the Netherlands began enforcing a ban on goods from Israeli settlements, Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said on Sunday. The officials have seven days to surrender their Israeli-issued diplomatic papers, he said.

daily.summary: Si les grands équilibres partisans devraient être conservés à l’issue de l’élection du dimanche 27 septembre, le Rassemblement national, avec son allié de l’UDR, le parti d’Eric Ciotti, pourra former, pour la première fois, un groupe au Palais du Luxembourg. daily.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic resigns to run for prime minister in October elections
daily.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic stepped down as the country's head of state Sunday, paving the way for him to run as his right-wing populist Serbian Progressive Party's candidate for prime minister in the October parliamentary elections.
